Title: Earth's Changing History - Part 2
Content: Figure `2` shows the different ecosystems of Madagascar and the locations of different species of mouse lemurs.

Because of Madagascar's location, lemurs became isolated from the rest of the world. More than `100` species `text(once)` inhabited the many different environmental niches found in Madagascar. When humans arrived in Madagascar, many of the lemur species went extinct because of hunting and other activities.
Table `2` shows the characteristics of some extinct and living lemur species.
